notes.title: First new expansion for Galactic Empire
notes.content:
1.1.0 Patch Notes - first expansion in game!

added text outline
changed stripe backgrounds for workers
scroll bars color
changed language selection field
NEW OPTION during game creation - BASIC ECONOMY - you can start a new game with mines and warehouses on level 5, coal power plant on level 10, plantations on level 7
new mechanics - SOCIAL GROUP LIMITS. You start the game with limits of 30 unemployed, 10 workers, 10 engineers, 10 civil servants. You can't hire a social class over the limit. To increase these limits, you need to build SLUMS, CONTAINERS, HOUSES, SKYRSKS. (for existing saves it will be 1000 [new buildings do not appear there])
4 NEW BUILDINGS - Slums, Containers, Houses, Skyscrapers [mentioned above]
1 NEW RESEARCH - Speach Translator - Each level permanently decreases cooldown for Galactic Objects by 2 [min. 5]
NEW OPTION - in each turn You can use engineers to reduce building time by 1 for currently under construction building
NEW OPTION - in each turn You can use clerks to reduce research time by 1 for currently ongoing research
Changed fast cannons - attack bonus 200% [instead of 50%]
Three times faster growth of ships on other planets


Check out now in game! : D
